lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Bitter Spring. Smells like coal smoke and somebody else's money.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: River's low for October. Whole valley's holding its breath.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Easy now. Easy. Nobody's shooting at you yet.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Whoa. I know. I heard it too.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Good girl. You earned your oats today.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: That's it. That's my girl.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Come on, then.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Here, girl!

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Morning.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Afternoon.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Evening.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Mister.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: You keep looking at me like that, you'll want to finish the thought.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Go on. Say it louder. I'm a little deaf on the gun side.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Nobody needs to bleed over this. Walk away.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Put it down, friend. It's too nice a day.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Hands where I can see them. Slow.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: That's one.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Stay down.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Who's next?

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Hold on. Hold on.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Damn it.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Breathe. Mark it. Squeeze.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Slow, Ruthie. Slow.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Box of forty-fours. And coffee, if it's honest coffee.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Just looking. Don't trouble yourself.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Wanted posters never do get my good side.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Tom used to say I aimed like I was angry at the air. I was. Mostly at him.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Six years of a good man. Three seconds of bad ones.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Meridian and Western. Pretty name for a noose.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Somebody put the coffee on before I start making speeches.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Rain at last. Too late for the corn. Just in time to drown me.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Get under something. Lightning don't care who's right.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Map says north. Map's never ridden this country.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: You didn't see a thing. Did you.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: All right. Let's go earn the name they gave me.
